title: Write integration tests for Reader endpoint security guards
description: Add integration tests to verify Reader endpoints reject oversized payloads (413), path traversal (safeResolveWorkspaceRoot throws), and NaN/Infinity weights (400). Also fix any existing tests broken by the new validation.
action: Add integration test cases to src-ts/tests/reader/reader-endpoints.test.ts: (1) rsSimulateEndpoint with text > 100000 chars returns 413; (2) rsSimulateEndpoint with novelId > 256 chars returns 413; (3) rsCreateCustomPersonaEndpoint with NaN weight returns 400; (4) rsCreateCustomPersonaEndpoint with Infinity weight returns 400; (5) rsCreateCustomPersonaEndpoint with weight 1.5 returns 400; (6) rsCreateCustomPersonaEndpoint with name > 200 chars returns 413. Also fix any existing tests that break due to safeResolveWorkspaceRoot containment check by ensuring test fixture directories are subdirectories of cwd.
